parameter.value: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Welcome to our humble farm.
Grace our home with another visit soon.
I can offer you cheese, cherries, pumpkins and melons.
I and my husband run this farm.
My husband Donald is busy on the fields almost all night and day.
It is a hard work, but the city needs us.
The weather is the best friend and the worst enemy of a farmer.
The druids helped us by placing a blessing on our fields.
It is hard to harvest everything, carry it to the mill in the north and make flour.
The miller is a lazy fellow and afraid of his own mill, because he thinks it is spooked.
King Tibianus granted us this farm to earn a living.
He is a friend of my husband.
We are mere peasants and do not know much about the guild leaders.
Spiders infested the sewers beneath our farm. We need some help to exterminate them. My husband pays a reward for killed spiders.
I can offer you cheese, cherries, pumpkins and melons.
I can offer you cheese, cherries, pumpkins and melons.
